== Summary ==
[[Toby Bengelsdorf]] reading at the August 2009 Quickies! reading series in Chicago ("Tobyfest"). Photographer: unknown. 240 × 320 px, the size shown in the post.

The post places this photo directly after the line introducing Toby Bengelsdorf.
* Match: the name is distinctive, and Decipher's 1997 Design a Card results list a finalist of that name.

== Fair use rationale ==
* '''Purpose:''' identifies the subject of the article [[Toby Bengelsdorf]].
* '''Portion used:''' the whole image at the low resolution shown in the post.
* '''Replaceability:''' no free photograph of him is known.
* '''Market effect:''' a small, non-commercial copy on a fan encyclopedia does not replace any commercial use.
* '''Copyright:''' the photographer or the QUICKIES! Chicago hosts. Used under fair use for identification only.
